title: Glasnost-era Russian crashed craft, US astronaut sent to help retrieve it

tellings.quote: one story that came up was that in the early days of glasnost when Russia and America were kind of friends again. Mhm. Russia imparted to America that it was in possession of a crashed craft

plain: In the early days of glasnost, the late-Soviet opening when Russia and America were briefly on friendly terms, Russia told America it had a crashed craft of unknown origin, and a US astronaut was sent to help recover it. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this as "one story that came up" among the accounts people have given him. If true, the two Cold War rivals would have quietly shared a secret about crashed non-human craft.
